resolved_findings.resolution: Monthly analyze start and terminal events use canonical context, opaque run ID, measured latency, evidence count, degraded flags and stable error codes.
Monthly persistence completion/failure is locally observable while failure remains nonfatal and idempotent persistence keys are unchanged.
Backtest start/completion/failure lifecycle uses current identity, available version metadata, measured latency and stable BACKTEST_EXECUTION_FAILED.
Direct and HTTP-level tests prove privacy, latency, raising-sink safety, persistence disposition and concurrent identity isolation.

contract_diff: Added optional monthly request context and compact monthly response fields while preserving the legacy request contract.
Added deterministic analysis identity and idempotent versioned forecast/outcome persistence; outcomes fail closed until observable.
Added app-scoped asynchronous backtest jobs, status and compact artifact endpoints using the closed Stage 09 engine.
Extended progress terminal handling for pipeline and backtest completion/failure.
Added monthly forecast/backtest frontend controls and kept DCF visually and semantically separate.
Added local allowlisted Stage 10B lifecycle telemetry without activating external exporters.

leakage_report.source: Closed Stage 09 leakage tests included in the combined suite

privacy_checks: Persistence stores redacted query/report/private state and compact evidence references only.
Telemetry allowlists context/version/count/status fields and drops query, user identity, raw evidence, reasoning, Manager state and exception payloads.
Failure events use ANALYSIS_PERSIST_FAILED, ANALYSIS_EXECUTION_FAILED or BACKTEST_EXECUTION_FAILED without exception text.
Raising local sinks are nonfatal and external exporters remain fail closed.
known_limitations: Validation used deterministic offline fixtures and mocks; live providers and real database writes were not exercised.
Backtest jobs are process-local rather than durable distributed jobs.
Frontend validation is static contract coverage rather than an interactive browser session.
out_of_scope_findings: A durable multi-worker backtest queue may be considered after the current refactor.
Live provider, migration and browser acceptance require separate explicit operational authorization.
rollback_instructions: Archive current Stage 10B source/test files and artifacts with the recorded SHA-256 values.
Restore only Stage 10B source/test paths to their pre-stage versions while retaining the complete audit chain.
Do not modify closed Stage 10A or earlier stage artifacts; no database rollback is required because no external write or migration ran.
